description: Calculate deterministic prop-firm drawdown survival math: remaining trailing buffer, max consecutive losses before daily or trailing breach, and recommended buffer-anchored 1R dollar and contract caps.

account_size.description: Nominal evaluation or funded account balance in USD (default 50000).

daily_loss_limit.description: Maximum single-day loss limit in USD (default 1000).

max_trailing_drawdown.description: Maximum trailing or static drawdown allowance in USD (default 2000).

planned_stop_points.description: Optional stop distance in index points (e.g., 10 points on NQ/MNQ).

point_value_usd.description: Dollar value per point per contract (default 20 for NQ; use 2 for MNQ, 50 for ES, 5 for MES).

risk_per_trade_usd.description: Planned dollar risk per trade (1R). Overrides planned_stop_points if provided.

name: calculate_prop_firm_drawdown
